comment: A specific semester (a semester type within an academic year) at a campus.

columns.name: semester_type
columns.comment: Which semester type this is (e.g. Winter, Summer) -- references semester_type.code.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the semester, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: academic_year
columns.comment: Academic year this semester falls in (e.g. 2026).

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Human-readable semester code, unique within its campus (the same code may be reused at a different campus).
